_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak — auto Send-Life from the Mailbox > Lives tab. Different screen/flow from sendlife.json (that one drives the home-screen Friends tab list); this one drives the Mailbox popup instead. Precondition: home screen (the Mailbox is opened and the Lives tab reached automatically — see open_mailbox; it was a manual-open precondition until 2026-08-08, when this config started being chained from boxrun's check_heart via run_config and needed to self-open). Once on Lives tab: the 'Received Lives are stored for 3 days.' list with per-friend 'Receive & Send' rows and the green 'Quick Receive & Send Lives' banner at the bottom. One tap on that banner opens a 'Send <name> a free Life?' confirm dialog (some friends show an extra '(+3 Gift Points)' line, some don't — live-verified both variants 2026-08-01); tapping Confirm sends it AND immediately re-opens the same dialog for the next friend in the list — no extra 'Message sent' popup in between. So the loop only needs to keep confirming until the dialog stops reappearing (list exhausted). SPEED-TUNED 2026-08-01: poll_ms and waits trimmed after live timing showed the dialog re-opens within ~500-700ms of a Confirm tap. All coords/templates verified live @1920x1080.

open_mailbox._note:
Entry point — home screen, Mailbox not open yet. Tap the envelope icon (bottom-right of the friends panel, unread-count badge cropped out of the template so it stays valid regardless of how many notices are pending) to open the Mailbox popup; it opens straight onto the Lives tab already selected (live-verified 2026-08-08 — no separate tab tap needed) so a single tap plus settle is enough to reach mailbox_base's screen. Absent (e.g. the Mailbox was already left open by a prior run that didn't reach 'done' cleanly) -> skip the tap and let mailbox_base's own detect decide what's actually on screen.

BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-08-08: home_play_marker found=True every poll (the state's own detect is fine) but tap_template 'mailbox_home_btn.png' scored 0.66 against the 0.85 threshold, raising ActError every single poll — caught and logged by the engine's per-action try/except, so the state never crashed, but it also never left: this state's own timeout_ms only fires on the on_absent path, and 'acted' is set True before the tap is attempted, so the no-action livelock detector never tripped either. Two real runs hung 5477s and 5115s before an unrelated external process restart broke them. Root cause: this state is entered straight from sendlife.json's bottom-of-list retry chain, whose last swipe can still be settling (Android list over-scroll bounce-back) when run_config hands off — src/fsm.py's _run_errand now sleeps 1s before starting any errand's Runner to cover exactly this, but progress_states/no_progress_goto below is the backstop in case some other cause produces the same silent tap-fail loop.

mailbox_base._note: Lives tab visible, no send-life dialog yet. detect is a 2-marker list: lives_tab_marker confirms we're on the right tab, quick_btn_marker is the actual Quick Receive & Send banner — present only when the friend list is non-empty. BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-08-18: when a friend's list has nobody to send to ('No Lives received! Send Lives to friends...'), the banner never renders at all, but lives_tab_marker alone still matched every poll, so the old single-marker detect kept re-entering on_match and tap_template kept firing on a template that plain isn't on screen (best score 0.19 < 0.85) — logged as a WARNING and skipped, forever, never reaching confirm_loop/done because 'acted' is set True before the tap runs so the no-action livelock detector never trips, and this state's own timeout_ms only fires on the on_absent path. Real run spammed this every ~1s until an external restart broke it. Fix: branch on which marker actually matched — quick_btn_marker present -> tap it -> confirm_loop (unchanged happy path); only lives_tab_marker (banner absent, empty list) -> skip straight to confirm_loop with no tap, same destination confirm_loop already reaches via on_absent for the genuinely-off-screen case.

confirm_loop._note: Marker is the Cancel+Confirm button ROW, not the dialog text — text-based detection broke live: some friends' dialog has no '(+3 Gift Points)' line at all, so a marker cropped from that line scored 0.42 (absent) on those and the bot falsely concluded the list was exhausted after 0 sends (caught 2026-08-01, wint3r's dialog had no Gift Points line). The button row is identical across every dialog variant (name-agnostic AND gift-points-agnostic) — scores 1.000 on both. Present -> tap Confirm via tap_template (jittered position + delay, per-poll fresh timing from poll_ms range) -> the same dialog re-opens for the next friend within ~500-700ms, so we just loop back and re-check. absent_retries tolerates the brief re-open gap without falsely concluding the list is done. CAPPED AT 30 CONFIRMS 2026-08-18 (user request: "ถ้าจดหมายมีไม่ถึง 30 ให้ส่งหัวใจเลย ไม่ต้องรอจดหมายหมด"). The list is not counted anywhere before opening it — the Lives tab shows rows, not a total, and the envelope badge on home counts Notices+Rewards, not Lives to receive — so the cap is expressed in confirms actually made, which is the same quantity one item at a time. Under 30 waiting Lives the loop still ends on its own the way it always did (measured live: 3 confirms, 19s end to end, including opening and closing the Mailbox); at 30 it stops collecting and hands off to `done` so the Send-Life pass starts instead of draining a long list first. Neither watchdog could express this: both ask whether the bot has stopped progressing, and a sweep working through a long list is progressing on every single pass. CAP EXIT FIXED 2026-08-19: max_visits_goto used to point straight at `done`, which leaks the dialog that is STILL on screen when the cap fires — the sweep stops mid-list, so item 31's 'Send X a free Life?' is open. `done` looks for alldone_marker (0.474 on that frame, absent), falls to close_mailbox, whose X at (1692,135) is covered by the dialog, so close_popup warned twice and `stop` handed control back to the farm loop with the dialog still up. The farm loop then walked its guard chain normally against a screen none of its guards match (sendlife_marker scores 0.598 there, under the 0.82 threshold) until the progress watchdog fired 601s later. Caught live 00:24-00:33. Now the cap exits through cap_close_dialog, which dismisses what is open before anything else runs.

cap_close_dialog._note: Closes the Send-Life dialog left open when confirm_loop hits its cap. Reached only from max_visits_goto, i.e. only when the sweep stopped with items still waiting. MEASURED LIVE 2026-08-19 on the stuck frame (Lives badge 70): the dialog's own X at (1432,270) is the only tap that LEAVES the queue — Cancel (727,687) accepts the current friend's Life and immediately re-opens the dialog for the next one (12 Cancel taps ran the badge 70 -> 37 and the heart counter up by 32, then the 'All Lives received and sent!' popup appeared), so Cancel drains the list rather than stopping, which is exactly what the cap exists to prevent. Confirm would do the same and send a Life besides. dialog_buttons_marker is the Cancel+Confirm button row (1.000 on that frame, 0.528 right after the X tap), the same marker confirm_loop detects, so absent means the dialog is already gone. close_popup re-reads the frame and taps again while the marker is still up, then warns if it never clears — a blind tap cannot tell a missed coordinate from a slow fade. Leaving this dialog open was the live bug: `done` looks for alldone_marker (0.474 there), fell through to close_mailbox, whose X at (1692,135) the dialog covers, and `stop` handed the farm loop a screen none of its guards match (sendlife_marker 0.598 < 0.82) until the progress watchdog fired 601s later.

done._note: List exhausted -> the 'All Lives received and sent!' popup fires (live-verified 2026-08-01, hearts went 495->726 confirming real sends, not a false-absent). Close it via Confirm so the run always ends on a clean Lives-tab screen, not a stray popup blocking the next launch. Absent (e.g. dialog stopped reappearing for some other reason, popup already gone) -> close_mailbox directly (the Mailbox itself is still open either way).

close_mailbox._note: Added 2026-08-08 when this config started being chained from boxrun's check_heart via run_config: a standalone run used to end deliberately parked on Lives tab (see 'done' above — that was fine when a person opened/closed the Mailbox by hand), but a chained run hands control straight back to the parent's own home-screen states, which would find the Mailbox popup sitting in front of everything. close_popup (not a bare tap) so the X actually landing gets verified before stop, same as every other popup-close in this repo. Absent -> the Mailbox was somehow already closed (a stray back-key, a fast tap racing this state) -> stop, nothing left to close.

recover_stuck._note: Progress watchdog entry (added 2026-08-08 with the on_match-tap-fail livelock above — no_progress_s 30 is short on purpose: every real progress_states hop happens within a few seconds in normal operation, so 30s of nothing is already well past any legitimate wait, unlike a farm loop's multi-minute run). Re-checks open_mailbox's own detect fresh: if the tap failure was transient (the settle-wait bounce, a slow frame) a second attempt from a clean poll often succeeds. Absent (home_play_marker gone — we're not even on home anymore, something else changed the screen entirely) or a second stall -> stop cleanly rather than let this errand hold the parent boxrun config hostage; the parent's own check_heart loop re-enters this config on its next heart-empty pass regardless, so nothing here is lost, only deferred.
